"""LLM draft interpretation with explicit input admission and bounded grounding checks."""

import asyncio
import hashlib
import re
from datetime import timedelta
from decimal import Decimal
from uuid import UUID

from pydantic import ValidationError

from ..core import models as m
from ..core.errors import ContractViolation
from ..core.serialization import semantic_hash
from .fallback import fallback


class InterpreterConfig(m.FrozenModel):
    provider_id: str
    protocol_id: str
    model_id: str
    prompt_version: str
    task_schema_version: str
    max_tokens: int
    time_limit_s: Decimal
    approved_message_hashes: tuple[str, ...]
    max_input_chars: int = 16000
    max_output_chars: int = 32000

    def checked(self):
        if (not 0 < self.time_limit_s <= 8 or type(self.max_tokens) is not int or self.max_tokens <= 0
                or self.max_input_chars <= 0 or self.max_output_chars <= 0
                or not all((self.provider_id, self.protocol_id, self.model_id,
                            self.prompt_version, self.task_schema_version))):
            raise ValueError("explicit compatible interpreter configuration required")
        return self


_PRIVATE = re.compile(
    r"reservation|fallback[_ ]?(?:cost|price|unit)|target[_ ]?price|ceiling|api[_ ]?key|secret|"
    r"buyer.{0,20}(?:budget|limit)|terminal[_ ]?score|expected[_ ]?(?:action|label)|private", re.I,
)
_CONDITIONAL = re.compile(r"\b(if|unless|provided|subject to|conditional)\b", re.I)
_CUES = {
    "request": r"\b(please|request|need|want|could you)\b",
    "refusal": r"\b(no|not|cannot|can't|won't|refuse|unable)\b",
    "conditional_offer": r"\b(if|unless|provided|subject to|conditional)\b",
    "constraint": r"\b(must|cannot|can't|minimum|maximum|at least|no more|require|only)\b",
    "approval_requirement": r"\b(approv|authori|manager|sign.off)",
    "stated_driver": r"\b(cost|energy|material|inflation|increase|capacity)\b",
    "ambiguity": r".+",
}
_UNKNOWN = {"approval", "discount", "conditions", "contradiction", "scope", "support", "supplier preference"}


def project(context, conversation, supplier_id, config):
    """Fail closed on unsupported history; never rewrite a source under its hash."""
    if conversation.session_id != context.snapshot.session_id:
        raise ContractViolation("scope_mismatch: foreign conversation")
    total = 0
    for msg in conversation.messages:
        total += len(msg.body)
        if (msg.speaker != "supplier" or msg.supplier_id != supplier_id
                or msg.content_hash != hashlib.sha256(msg.body.encode()).hexdigest()
                or msg.content_hash not in config.approved_message_hashes
                or msg.attachments or msg.observed_sheets or msg.claim_results
                or msg.role is not None or msg.from_name is not None or _PRIVATE.search(msg.body)):
            raise ContractViolation("private_disclosure: source requires an approved purpose projection")
    if total > config.max_input_chars or not conversation.messages:
        raise ContractViolation("unsupported_capability: empty/oversized input")
    # Raw evidence and previous assessment may contain private prose/numeric effects.
    # This increment excludes them entirely; runtime still preserves parent linkage.
    return m.InterpretInput(kind="interpret", snapshot=context.snapshot, supplier_id=supplier_id,
                            conversation=conversation, evidence=(), previous=None)


def ground(draft, projection):
    messages = {msg.message_id: msg for msg in projection.conversation.messages}
    observations = {o.observation_id: o for o in draft.observations}
    if len(observations) != len(draft.observations):
        raise ContractViolation("ungrounded_output: duplicate observation identity")

    def citation(c):
        if not isinstance(c, m.MessageSpan):
            raise ContractViolation("missing_source: evidence excluded from this projection")
        msg = messages.get(c.message_id)
        if (msg is None or c.session_id != msg.session_id or c.thread_id != msg.thread_id
                or c.end > len(msg.body) or msg.body[c.start:c.end] != c.quote):
            raise ContractViolation("ungrounded_output: invalid message span")
        if _CONDITIONAL.search(msg.body) and (c.start != 0 or c.end != len(msg.body)):
            raise ContractViolation("ungrounded_output: conditional antecedent must be retained")
        return c.quote

    for obs in draft.observations:
        quotes = tuple(citation(c) for c in obs.citations)
        if obs.summary not in quotes or not any(re.search(_CUES[obs.kind], q, re.I) for q in quotes):
            raise ContractViolation("ungrounded_output: quotation does not support bounded observation kind")
        if obs.kind != "conditional_offer" and any(_CONDITIONAL.search(q) for q in quotes):
            if obs.kind not in ("refusal", "approval_requirement", "ambiguity"):
                raise ContractViolation("ungrounded_output: conditional statement mislabeled unconditional")
        if obs.package_fingerprint is not None:
            raise ContractViolation("ungrounded_output: no package reference admitted in this input slice")
    for constraint in draft.reported_constraints:
        quotes = tuple(citation(c) for c in constraint.citations)
        value = str(constraint.value)
        if (not quotes or not any(re.search(r"(?<![\w.])" + re.escape(value) + r"(?![\w.])", q) for q in quotes)
                or not any(re.search(_CUES["constraint"], q, re.I) for q in quotes)
                or any(re.search(r"\b(prefer|would like)\b", q, re.I) for q in quotes)
                or not set(constraint.condition_observation_refs) <= observations.keys()):
            raise ContractViolation("ungrounded_output: unsupported explicit constraint")
        cues = {"==": r"\b(only|exactly|must be|require)\b", "!=": r"\b(not|cannot|can't)\b",
                ">=": r"\b(at least|minimum)\b", "<=": r"\b(at most|maximum|no more)\b"}
        dimensions = {"payment_days": r"\bpayment\b", "lead_time_days": r"\b(delivery|lead)\b",
                      "unit_price": r"\b(price|EUR|€)\b", "volume_per_year": r"\b(volume|units)\b",
                      "contract_months": r"\b(contract|months)\b"}
        if (constraint.dimension not in dimensions
                or not any(re.search(dimensions[constraint.dimension], q, re.I)
                           and re.search(cues[constraint.op], q, re.I) for q in quotes)):
            raise ContractViolation("ungrounded_output: unsupported dimension/operator")
        conditional = any(_CONDITIONAL.search(q) for q in quotes)
        linked = [observations[r] for r in constraint.condition_observation_refs]
        if conditional and not any(o.kind == "conditional_offer" and set(o.citations) & set(constraint.citations)
                                   for o in linked):
            raise ContractViolation("ungrounded_output: conditional constraint lost its antecedent")
    for hypothesis in draft.hypotheses:
        quotes = tuple(citation(c) for c in (*hypothesis.supporting_refs, *hypothesis.contradicting_refs))
        if (not quotes or hypothesis.summary not in quotes or hypothesis.numeric_effect is not None
                or hypothesis.confidence not in ("low", "unknown")):
            raise ContractViolation("ungrounded_output: uncalibrated or unsupported hypothesis")
        if hypothesis.relation == "prefers" and not any(re.search(r"\b(prefer|rather|would like)\b", q, re.I)
                                                        for q in quotes):
            raise ContractViolation("ungrounded_output: preference lacks an explicit cue")
    for uncertainty in draft.uncertainties:
        quotes = tuple(citation(c) for c in uncertainty.citations)
        if (not quotes or uncertainty.summary not in quotes
                or not set(uncertainty.related_observation_refs) <= observations.keys()):
            raise ContractViolation("ungrounded_output: unsupported uncertainty")
    # Questions are internal suggestions, not registered outbound templates in this slice.
    if draft.questions or not set(draft.unknowns) <= _UNKNOWN:
        raise ContractViolation("unsupported_capability: unregistered question/unknown label")
    for obs in draft.observations:
        if obs.kind == "approval_requirement" and "approval" not in draft.unknowns:
            raise ContractViolation("ungrounded_output: approval authority must remain unknown")
    for a in draft.reported_constraints:
        for b in draft.reported_constraints:
            if (a.constraint_id != b.constraint_id and a.dimension == b.dimension and a.op == b.op == "=="
                    and a.value != b.value and a.status == b.status == "active"
                    and not any(u.kind == "contradiction" and u.blocking for u in draft.uncertainties)):
                raise ContractViolation("ungrounded_output: contradictory constraints need blocking uncertainty")
    return draft


class GroundedInterpreter:
    def __init__(self, *, model, clock, config: InterpreterConfig):
        self.model = model
        self.clock = clock
        self.config = config.checked()

    def decision_scope(self, ledger):
        return self.model.decision_scope(ledger)

    async def interpret(self, context, conversation, previous_assessment, budget):
        supplier_id = next((t.supplier_id for t in conversation.messages), None)
        if supplier_id not in context.case.supplier_ids:
            raise ContractViolation("scope_mismatch: unidentified interpretation target")
        call_id = None
        try:
            projection = project(context, conversation, supplier_id, self.config)
            reserves = float(budget.fallback_reserve_s + budget.submission_reserve_s)
            seconds = min(float(self.config.time_limit_s), float(budget.model_time_limit_s),
                          float(budget.compute_limit_s) - reserves,
                          (budget.deadline_at - self.clock.utcnow()).total_seconds() - reserves)
            if budget.model_call_limit < 1 or seconds <= 0:
                raise ContractViolation("model_timeout: no inference allowance remains")
            # Content-derived call identity supports recorded replay without provider-generated IDs.
            digest = semantic_hash((projection, self.config.model_dump(exclude={"approved_message_hashes"})))
            call_id = UUID(hex=digest[:32])
            request = m.ModelRequest(
                call_id=call_id, task="interpret", task_schema_version=self.config.task_schema_version,
                prompt_version=self.config.prompt_version, input=projection,
                provider_id=self.config.provider_id, model_id=self.config.model_id, protocol_id=self.config.protocol_id,
                output_schema_hash=semantic_hash(m.AssessmentDraft.model_json_schema()), correlation_id=call_id,
            )
            mb = m.ModelBudget(deadline_at=self.clock.utcnow() + timedelta(seconds=seconds),
                               time_limit_s=Decimal(str(seconds)), max_tokens=self.config.max_tokens,
                               max_calls=1, retry_limit=0)
            result = await self.model.complete(request, mb)
            if result.call_id != call_id or result.model_id != self.config.model_id:
                raise ContractViolation("model_invalid: call/model mismatch")
            if result.kind != "success":
                raise ContractViolation(result.issues[0].code + ": inference unavailable")
            if self.clock.utcnow() >= mb.deadline_at:
                raise ContractViolation("model_timeout: late result")
            if len(result.raw_response_json) > self.config.max_output_chars or _PRIVATE.search(result.raw_response_json):
                raise ContractViolation("private_disclosure: unsafe/oversized model output")
            draft = ground(m.AssessmentDraft.model_validate_json(result.raw_response_json), projection)
            assessment = m.SupplierAssessment(
                assessment_id="pending", supplier_id=supplier_id, snapshot=context.snapshot,
                revision=previous_assessment.revision + 1 if previous_assessment else 1,
                **draft.model_dump(exclude={"schema_version"}), status="ok", interpreter_id="grounded-interpreter-v1",
                model_call_id=str(call_id), parent_assessment_id=previous_assessment.assessment_id if previous_assessment else None,
            )
            return assessment.model_copy(update={
                "assessment_id": "sha256:" + semantic_hash(assessment.model_dump(mode="json", exclude={"assessment_id"})),
            })
        except asyncio.CancelledError:
            raise
        except (ContractViolation, ValidationError, ValueError, TimeoutError) as error:
            code = str(error).split(":", 1)[0]
            if code not in m.IssueCode.__args__:
                code = "model_invalid"
            return await fallback(context, conversation, previous_assessment, budget, supplier_id, code,
                                  str(call_id) if call_id else None)

"""Budgeted fake-transport plumbing and bounded semantics; no model-quality claim."""

import asyncio
import hashlib
import json
from decimal import Decimal
from uuid import UUID

import pytest

from negotiator.v2.adapters.model import AsyncModelGateway
from negotiator.v2.core import models as m
from negotiator.v2.core.serialization import semantic_hash
from negotiator.v2.intelligence.interpreter import GroundedInterpreter, InterpreterConfig
from negotiator.v2.orchestration.budgets import DecisionModelLedger, failure
from negotiator.v2.orchestration.offline import OfflineDecisionTrace
from tests.v2.contracts.test_layered_resolver import changed
from tests.v2.fakes import FakeClock
from tests.v2.integration.test_offline_decision import recorded, services


def setup(relationship, body="We prefer delivery flexibility.", *, seconds="1", tokens=2048):
    inputs = recorded(relationship, body=body)
    inputs = changed(inputs, budget=changed(inputs.budget, model_call_limit=2, model_time_limit_s=Decimal(seconds)))
    assembler, coordinator = services(inputs)
    snapshot = assembler.assemble(inputs)
    clock = FakeClock()
    ledger = DecisionModelLedger(budget=inputs.budget, clock=clock, token_limit=tokens)
    config = InterpreterConfig(provider_id="fake", protocol_id="injected-v1", model_id="test-model",
                               prompt_version="grounded-supplier-v1", task_schema_version="assessment-draft-v1",
                               max_tokens=512, time_limit_s=Decimal(seconds),
                               approved_message_hashes=tuple(msg.content_hash for msg in snapshot.conversation.messages))
    return inputs, snapshot, coordinator, clock, ledger, config


def draft(snapshot, kind="ambiguity", **updates):
    msg = snapshot.conversation.messages[0]
    span = m.MessageSpan(session_id=msg.session_id, thread_id=msg.thread_id, message_id=msg.message_id,
                         start=0, end=len(msg.body), quote=msg.body)
    observation = m.GroundedObservation(observation_id="observation:1", kind=kind, dimension=None,
                                        summary=msg.body, citations=(span,))
    return m.AssessmentDraft(observations=(observation,), reported_constraints=(), hypotheses=(),
                             uncertainties=(), questions=(), unknowns=(), **updates)


def success(request, raw, usage=None):
    return m.ModelSuccess(kind="success", call_id=request.call_id, model_id=request.model_id,
                          elapsed_s=Decimal("0"), issues=(), raw_response_json=raw,
                          response_hash=hashlib.sha256(raw.encode()).hexdigest(), usage=usage or m.ModelUsage())


class Transport:
    def __init__(self, raw, *, kind="success", usage=None):
        self.raw, self.kind, self.usage = raw, kind, usage
        self.calls = []

    async def __call__(self, request, budget):
        self.calls.append((request, budget))
        return success(request, self.raw, self.usage) if self.kind == "success" else failure(request, self.kind, "scripted")


def interpreter(clock, ledger, config, transport):
    gateway = AsyncModelGateway(transport=transport, ledger=ledger)
    return GroundedInterpreter(model=gateway, clock=clock, config=config)


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_interpreter_and_coordinator_retain_attributed_usage_and_safe_raw(relationship):
    inputs, snapshot, coordinator, clock, ledger, config = setup(relationship)
    raw = draft(snapshot).model_dump_json()
    transport = Transport(raw, usage=m.ModelUsage(input_tokens=100, output_tokens=60))
    coordinator.interpreter = interpreter(clock, ledger, config, transport)
    coordinator.model_token_limit = 2048
    trace = await coordinator.run_once(snapshot, recorded_input_bytes=inputs.model_dump_json().encode())
    assert trace.assessment.status == "ok"
    assert trace.validation.kind == "valid"
    assert trace.assessment.model_call_id == str(trace.model_calls[0].request.call_id)
    assert trace.model_calls[0].usage.input_tokens == 100
    assert trace.model_calls[0].charged_tokens == 160
    assert trace.model_calls[0].permitted_raw_response == raw
    assert trace.model_calls[0].response_hash == hashlib.sha256(raw.encode()).hexdigest()
    assert trace.model_calls[0].request_hash == semantic_hash(trace.model_calls[0].request)
    restored = OfflineDecisionTrace.model_validate_json(trace.model_dump_json())
    restored.verify()
    assert restored == trace
    # A second decision owns a fresh ledger; the explicit standalone ledger was unused.
    assert ledger.calls == 0

@pytest.mark.parametrize("mode", ("hung", "late", "cancel", "reserves", "mismatch", "transport"))
@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_deadline_cancel_identity_and_transport_paths(relationship, mode):
    _, snapshot, _, clock, ledger, config = setup(relationship, seconds="0.02")
    cancelled = asyncio.Event()

    async def transport(request, budget):
        if mode in ("hung", "cancel"):
            try:
                await asyncio.Event().wait()
            finally:
                cancelled.set()
        if mode == "transport":
            raise OSError("SECRET should never reach trace")
        if mode == "late":
            clock.advance(60)
        result = success(request, draft(snapshot).model_dump_json())
        return changed(result, call_id=UUID(int=3)) if mode == "mismatch" else result

    component = interpreter(clock, ledger, config, transport)
    if mode == "reserves":
        clock.advance(9)
    task = asyncio.create_task(component.interpret(snapshot.context, snapshot.conversation, None, snapshot.budget))
    if mode == "cancel":
        await asyncio.sleep(0.001)
        task.cancel()
        with pytest.raises(asyncio.CancelledError):
            await task
        await asyncio.wait_for(cancelled.wait(), 0.1)
        assert ledger.traces[0].result_kind == "cancelled"
    else:
        result = await asyncio.wait_for(task, 0.2)
        assert result.status == "fallback"
        if mode == "hung":
            await asyncio.wait_for(cancelled.wait(), 0.1)
        assert "SECRET" not in str(ledger.traces)

"""Score exported assessments against provisional labels; never used by production prompts.

Usage: .venv/bin/python experiments/v2/evaluate_interpretation.py predictions.json
Predictions are a list of {id, assessment: <SupplierAssessment JSON>, critical_errors: []}.
Critical-error annotations require external review; missing annotations stay unreviewed.
"""

import argparse
import json
from pathlib import Path

from negotiator.v2.core.models import SupplierAssessment


def evaluate(labels, predictions):
    by_id = {p["id"]: p for p in predictions}
    if len(by_id) != len(predictions) or not set(by_id) <= {s["id"] for s in labels["examples"]}:
        raise ValueError("duplicate/unknown prediction IDs")
    tp = fp = fn = abstentions = grounding = unsupported = missing = fallbacks = unreviewed = 0
    critical = 0
    categories = {}
    for example in labels["examples"]:
        record = by_id.get(example["id"])
        expected = set(example["observation_kinds"])
        if record is None:
            missing += 1
            fn += len(expected)
            continue
        assessment = SupplierAssessment.model_validate_json(json.dumps(record["assessment"]))
        observed = {o.kind for o in assessment.observations} if assessment.status == "ok" else set()
        abstentions += assessment.status != "ok"
        fallbacks += assessment.status == "fallback"
        grounding += "ungrounded_output" in assessment.unknowns or "missing_source" in assessment.unknowns
        unsupported += "unsupported_claim" in assessment.unknowns
        tp += len(expected & observed)
        fp += len(observed - expected)
        fn += len(expected - observed)
        categories.setdefault(example["group"], []).append({
            "id": example["id"], "expected": sorted(expected), "observed": sorted(observed),
            "missing_unknowns": sorted(set(example["unknowns"]) - set(assessment.unknowns)),
            "status": assessment.status,
        })
        if "critical_errors" not in record:
            unreviewed += 1
        else:
            critical += len(record["critical_errors"])
    return {"label_review": labels["review_status"], "denominator": len(labels["examples"]),
            "prediction_count": len(predictions), "missing": missing,
            "precision": tp / (tp + fp) if tp + fp else None,
            "recall": tp / (tp + fn) if tp + fn else None,
            "abstentions": abstentions, "fallbacks": fallbacks, "grounding_failures": grounding,
            "unsupported_claim_failures": unsupported, "critical_errors": critical,
            "critical_review_missing": unreviewed, "categories": categories,
            "claim_scope": "measured exported outputs only; scripted drafts do not measure model understanding"}


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("predictions", type=Path)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
    labels = json.loads((root / "tests/fixtures/v2/interpretation-pilot.json").read_text())
    print(json.dumps(evaluate(labels, json.loads(args.predictions.read_text())), indent=2))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

## Working path

AsyncModelGateway delegates to an injected async transport. Every invocation requires a
DecisionModelLedger, either explicitly supplied for direct component use or bound by the
coordinator. The transport resolves the explicit provider/model/protocol/prompt/schema IDs;
there is no concrete hosted provider adapter. The registered interpretation prompt is
src/negotiator/v2/intelligence/prompts/grounded-supplier-v1.txt. A future provider transport
must implement that prompt/protocol and honor the supplied total token reservation, including
input and output. Provider/tokenizer compatibility and real usage remain unmeasured.

GroundedInterpreter requires explicit InterpreterConfig: provider/protocol/model, purpose
prompt/schema versions, per-call time/token bounds, input/output size limits and approved
supplier message hashes. The first projection excludes all raw evidence and prior assessment
text, and refuses buyer/mixed history, unapproved messages, documents/sheets/metadata and
recognized private prose. It never redacts content under an original identity or silently
truncates a ConversationView. Message hashes are recomputed from exact body bytes. Approval
of source content is an explicit caller obligation; the lexical private-data guard is defense
in depth, not a universal confidentiality classifier. Prior parent/revision linkage remains
in the resulting local assessment.

Model drafts are decoded as strict AssessmentDraft. Scoped exact spans, complete conditional
antecedents, explicit numeric values/operators/dimensions, observation references, supported
kind cues, approval unknowns and contradictory active equality constraints are checked.

low/unknown-confidence hypotheses without numeric effects. Reported costs cannot become
canonical facts. Internal clarification suggestions are limited to clarify:terms and a fixed
information description; they do not register new outbound actions. Arbitrary paraphrase/
entailment, broad linguistic operators, role changes and comprehensive contradiction
resolution are not certified; uncertain/unsupported drafts fall back.

One coordinator decision binds one ledger across gateway consumers and async stages. Calls
are reserved before awaiting, capped by DecisionBudget (at most two), with no retry/reset
from new requests. Token reservations use explicit configured upper bounds; complete known
usage refunds unused capacity, partial/missing usage retains the full reservation and stays
null in attribution. Reported overruns are retained and rejected, blocking further admissions;
no claim is made that an untrusted transport can be forced to honor a remote token cap.

absolute deadline and fallback/submission reserves. Timeouts/cancellation cancel the task;
cancellation-resistant late completions are observed and never applied. External cancellation
propagates. Exceptions are mapped without copying potentially secret exception text.

no commercial/economic inference. The existing fixed strategy/economics/renderer/independent
validator remain in place. Traces retain filtered requests/hashes, result category, actual
